version.description: the vocabulary's version: raise it to train a new vocabulary (more data, another size, a new tokenizer); until then the locked one is reused

depot.description: the address of the depot whose texts train the vocabulary: a folder or a bucket; empty until a person names it, and the check names each recipe to fill in

dataset.description: the name of the dataset of that depot whose texts train the vocabulary; empty until a person names it, and the check names each recipe to fill in

sample_bytes.description: the bytes of text, at most, of the sample of that dataset's texts that trains the vocabulary
